reviews.notes: Names all 8 classes (Hospital, Department, Doctor, Nurse, Patient, Appointment, MedicalRecord, Prescription) and covers all 9 relationships in diagram order: Hospital*--Department, Department o--Doctor, Department o--Nurse, Patient-->Appointment (books), Doctor-->Appointment (conducts), Appointment-->MedicalRecord (generates), Doctor-->Prescription (issues), Patient*--MedicalRecord, Prescription-->Patient (dispensed to). Correctly distinguishes composition vs aggregation vs labeled association wording.

Enumerates all 8 classes up front and states there are 9 relationships, then lists each one individually with its exact edge label where present. Matches the diagram line for line; no invented relationships or classes.

Starts from Prescription-->Patient and traces backward through the appointment/record chain, then zooms out to the Department/Doctor/Nurse/Hospital aggregation and composition structure. All 8 classes and all 9 relationships are covered, including the closing summary tally matching nodeCount/edgeCount.
